call_input.prompt:
Create exactly ONE finished flat Korean online recruitment poster, landscape aspect ratio exactly 3:2. Request the maximum possible native resolution supported by the current tool and model while maintaining 3:2. The output is the poster itself edge to edge, not a photograph of a poster, not a mockup, frame, collage, contact sheet or multiple designs. Opaque background.

Art direction: A shared beach cleanup becomes a shared reading path. Show ONE coherent illustrated coastal scene with three adult volunteers simultaneously cleaning the same stretch of sand, viewed from a lightly elevated side angle. One person operates a long litter picker visibly gripping a small discarded plastic bottle; the gripped bottle is near the open mouth of a rubbish bag held by another person. The third person works nearby with a separate picker, with feet firmly on the sand. Hand-to-handle, picker-to-bottle and bag-opening relationships must be structurally clear. Their bodies and tools point inward toward the shared bag, with the beach edge and open sand making a visual path between recruitment, practical attendance information and preparation. Avoid portrait-like facial detail. Use economical, convincing editorial illustration with crisp dark contours, matte flat color shapes and a few selective material details, no global grain or faux paper treatment. Restrained ocean blue, dark ink blue, pale sandy background and a useful orange emphasis for the application. The three people must inhabit a single scene, not isolated icons or successive photographs.

Information design must start from readability: at a 720-pixel-wide viewing size, ALL twelve supplied texts must be readable, especially the long rain-cancellation sentence and the personal-preparation sentence. Use substantial clean Korean sans-serif lettering, robust strokes, regular spacing, high contrast, generous line spacing, and stable alignment. Do not shrink fine print into a footer. Give the full long conditions enough width and natural word-boundary wrapping. Artwork may be reduced to make the words clear.

A concrete landscape composition: upper-left recruitment and its emotional headline form a close, strong opening; upper-right a prominent orange application area carries the application deadline and entire URL with a nearby inquiry line. The recruitment name and application should be within the same immediate field of attention. Beneath the opening, on the left, the event date, time, place and eligibility form one generously spaced attendance group. The shared cleanup illustration occupies the central right, with its sand boundary and tool direction aligned toward the adjoining information; below and beside the same scene put the provision and preparation sentences as a paired preparation judgment. The rain notification and the free/no-certificate condition run in wide clearly readable rows near those groups. Use spatial gaps and different existing text weights to create groups, not invented group titles or icons. Do not put the other ten texts together in a small bottom band. Preserve generous safe margins and keep every letter inside the canvas. The illustration and all text should belong to one composed poster.

The event date and application deadline must be distinct. The application URL is a complete contiguous readable Latin string; no breaks inside the URL, no substitutions. Display each of the following twelve exact text values ONCE, with exactly their spelling, Korean spacing, punctuation, case and numbers. Line breaks may be made only at natural word boundaries without changing the text. Do not print quotation marks or list numbers around them. No other text, group heading, decorative characters, icons, fake logo, watermark, invented claims or QR code:
우리 바다, 함께 줍는 토요일
하람 해변 정화 참여자 모집
2026년 11월 21일 토요일
오전 9시 30분 집결 · 낮 12시 종료
하람시 물결마당 앞 · 파도길 8
대상: 만 14세 이상 누구나 · 선착순 40명
집게와 수거 봉투는 제공됩니다.
개인 장갑, 마실 물, 모자를 준비해 주세요.
우천 시 취소되며 신청자에게 전날 문자로 안내합니다.
참가비 무료 · 봉사 확인서는 발급하지 않습니다.
11월 18일까지 신청: haram-wave.example/join
문의: 바다정화 운영팀

Carefully render every Korean glyph, interpunct, colon, comma and period. Do not replace or abbreviate any sentence. Deliver a complete independent single flat poster with the requested landscape ratio.
